newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slowly at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade slowly at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady in a light test, USDA said. Inquiry strong and demand fair.

Sales confirmed on 800 slaughter steers and 1,000 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 84,400 head confirmed including 14,900 head or about 18 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1275 lbs 72.00. Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 72.00.
Wk to date - 84,400 last week - 76,800 last year - 60,000
